title: Do not illustrate text

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Protect the distinction between text and illustration so decorative lettering does not replace the city’s typographic voice.
strategic_value: A controlled exception process can preserve Helsinki’s identity while permitting small illustrative uses when appropriate.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section states the restriction and permission exception, then contrasts a crossed-out decorative headline with prescribed typography in an illustrated poster.
practical_value: Keep important words typographic; seek the specified review for an incidental word inside an illustration.

content_islands.name: Rule and exception
content_islands.spec: Explain the restriction and individual-permission condition.

content_islands.name: Headline comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the decorative-lettering poster at left with a red strike and the conventional-type alternative at right.

ingredient.name: Text versus illustration
ingredient.role: Keep the main verbal message in the prescribed typography.
ingredient.application: Do not illustrate titles or words; consult city brand/design experts for the stated incidental-text exception.
ingredient.scope: Approval may apply when text is integral to an illustration and does not play a significant role in the application.

reference_purposes.Application: The section supplies an illustrated-word example against its policy.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Illustrated titles, words and text are not allowed except individually approved, integral and insignificant illustrative text.
